app.name: ShellyLanMan
banner.noAuth: UI authentication is off: anyone who can reach this address can use ShellyLanMan. Keep it on a trusted network.
state.notYet: Not available yet in this version.
devices.table.title: Devices
devices.empty.title: No devices yet
devices.empty.text: No device found yet. Discovery keeps running; check the scan mode in Settings → Network.
page.checklist.text: The configuration checklist (eco mode, LED, logs, BLE, access point, roaming, Wi-Fi, range extender, scripts, automatic firmware update) will appear here.
page.charts.text: Live charts of power, voltage, current, temperature, humidity, RSSI and more will appear here.
page.firmware.text: Firmware check and update per device, and the QR code for a local firmware download, will appear here.
page.deferred.text: Actions queued for offline devices will appear here and run when the device comes back online.
appearance.note: Appearance is stored in this browser only.
about.notice: ShellyLanMan is an independent project. It is not ShellyScanner and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Shelly Group. Shelly is a trademark of its owner.
about.basedOnText: ShellyLanMan is based on {name} by {author}: its functional and code reference.
firstrun.title: Welcome to ShellyLanMan
firstrun.text: ShellyLanMan discovers, monitors and manages Shelly devices on your local network. It is based on ShellyScanner by usnasoft.
firstrun.authNote: UI authentication is off by default. Only run ShellyLanMan on a network you trust, or put it behind a reverse proxy with authentication.
col.name: Name
login.title: Device login
login.useForAll: Use as default for all protected devices
login.stored: Credentials are stored encrypted in /data and never shown again.
action.reloadTip: Read the device again from its address
action.removeGhostConfirm: Remove this device from the archive?
action.removeGhostNotes: Its note will be deleted. Do you confirm?
scan.mdnsError: mDNS discovery could not start: {err}. Use IP scan, or run the container with host networking.
scan.noMdns: No device has answered mDNS after 30 seconds. In Docker bridge networking mDNS does not work: use network_mode: host, or switch to IP scan in Settings → Network.
scan.offline: Offline mode: showing archived devices only (Settings → Network).
scan.ticsHelp: How many status refreshes run before the configuration is refreshed too; 1 means every time. Full-rate refresh runs only while a browser has ShellyLanMan open; otherwise devices are checked once a minute.
cred.title: Restricted login
cred.text: Default credentials for protected devices (Gen2+ devices always use the user admin). Per-device credentials can be set with Login on a device.
archive.text: The archive remembers devices, their last address and your notes, so devices that are off or asleep still appear (as archived).
archive.autoReload: Auto reload (mDNS modes: about 45 s after a scan starts, archived devices are looked for at their last address)
archive.clearConfirm: Notes will be permanently deleted. Do you confirm?
filter.label: Filter devices
action.webUITip: Open the device's own web interface
action.webConfirm: {n} web pages will open. Do you confirm?
logs.paused: ShellyLanMan refresh suspended for this device
logs.hint: Shows the device's debug log when its websocket log is enabled (Checklist → Logs).
prefs.note: These display options are stored in this browser.
